reviewedBy: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (implementing agent, self-review; not a cold reviewer)
method: Self-review by the agent that wrote the change, on a local dev server reading production through a preload that blocks every write (read-only). Walked at 1440x900 and 375x812: the album report's Recaps section as a visitor (before any backfill, where it is absent; after a backfill; with recaps still to come; with one due and not yet stored), as a harness owner (nothing written; one due and waiting), an opened recap from a backfill, an opened on-time recap, a synthetic late and incomplete day 7 and a recap asked for that is not stored; Home's Next (live and two as-of shifts); and Settings (signed out, and a harness owner with the two private API reads stubbed in the browser: no retention, retention chosen, email on). Stored recaps in the captures are real production numbers replayed by the repository's own scripts and presented by the preload. All 14 recap texts for the 7 real launches were read in full after the wording changes. Gates per capture: overflow (forced to fail once per page and width, 34 of 34 fired), 44 px targets, text at 200 percent, Tab-only keyboard walk. Not covered: a cold reviewer; a real signed-in session; the email path end to end (no destination is verified and nothing was sent); album photos (images do not load in the sandbox); largest system text size and increased contrast beyond the 200 percent text and the prefers-contrast rules in the source; the owner-only IntelligenceWorkspace incident list and its Playwright tests (five of eight skip without the rehearsal owner cookie).
